fresh_primary_external_evidence.finding: http.server is explicitly not recommended for production and provides only basic security checks
Uvicorn supports production deployment/process management and defaults to one worker unless configured otherwise
HTTPS is commonly terminated by an external TLS termination proxy
Nginx provides HTTPS and reverse proxy support

candidate_direction.reason: Multiple application workers are not automatically compatible with the current V16 process-local continuation projection and global single-spawn invariant.

required_next_discriminators: verify target-VPS package/runtime availability before selecting framework
prove every network request enters authenticated token ingress before touching execution state
prove one global busy lease under concurrent remote clients
prove same-session continuation and idempotent replay through the real transport
prove idle-handoff/epoch fence behavior through the real transport
prove proxy/TLS headers cannot forge caller identity or bypass token scope
measure latency, memory, request concurrency and recovery on accepted target VPS
do not enable multiple application workers until durable cross-process continuation equivalence is proven
